title: Commit 121d8a0 re-bless scope names qos.log.bin, but the log is byte-identical to r1 — its only PR-level change is the story-commit catalog_hash fold, not the churn fix
evidence:
git log -1 --format=%B 121d8a0:
"Re-bless scope (all cause-documented): qos T1/log/PNGs (the churn fix + the
mojibake), warn 65s PNG + surge PNGs + one new capture (mojibake + the T2
bracket); everything else byte-identical."
"SCOPE CORRECTION: the r1-fix round claimed qos T1/log/T2 re-blessed — false
(the log + PNGs were byte-identical; only qos.t1 moved)."
git rev-parse f906725:goldens/qos.log.bin -> 1573c7f43cd50f99a6d5da240cba0905ecdb9d6c
git rev-parse 121d8a0:goldens/qos.log.bin -> 1573c7f43cd50f99a6d5da240cba0905ecdb9d6c
git diff --stat f906725 121d8a0 -- goldens/ lists 6 files (qos.t1, qos/65000ms.png, surge/*, warn/*) — no qos.log.bin
detail: The commit claims the qos log re-blessed with cause 'the churn fix + the mojibake', but the log is byte-identical between f906725 and 121d8a0. Its only PR-level change was the story-commit catalog_hash fold — the scope error W-qos flagged, repeated in the new message.
recommended_fix: Amend the commit message scope: qos re-bless this commit = t1 + 65000ms.png (churn fix + mojibake); the log moved only at the story commit (catalog_hash fold, spec-4-2-documented).
